# EOL Product List

InHand Networks has announced end-of-life (EOL) for the products below. Please plan replacements with the listed successor series to keep your deployments supported.

- **End of Ordering** — no orders accepted after this date.
- **End of Production** — no units manufactured after this date.
- **End of Support** — no technical support or maintenance after this date.

The same list is published at <https://www.inhand.com/en/support/eol-products>. Both are generated from one source; InHand Networks reserves the right to update this information at any time.
